text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $78k while Ethereum has dipped slightly more, suggesting traders are rotating defensively toward the largest asset; the broader market weakness in altcoins like SOL and BNB signals risk-off positioning. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 62 but has contracted 11 points over a week, indicating sentiment is cooling despite prices remaining resilient. Volume at $68B is moderate, and Bitcoin dominance climbing toward 60% reflects capital concentrating in the safest assets rather than flowing into riskier alternatives.
